summary: A specialist focus and a CQC report link are strengths, but typos, a dead menu item and no contact form appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The Dermatology menu item links to #, and the Our services link points to an anchor that does not appear.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot reach your main service pages from the menu.

findings.problem: The page shows 'Basel Cell Carcinoma' and 'skin deseases', and the blog section lists no posts.
findings.cost: Spelling errors on medical terms make patients doubt expertise.
findings.fix: Proofread medical copy and a real blog section.

findings.problem: The header lists two phone numbers, 0207 299 0392 and 0207 467 8300, while the footer lists only the first.
findings.cost: Patients are unsure which number to call.

findings.problem: No contact form appears, booking relies on a third party link, and no reviews or registration details are shown.
findings.cost: Patients who want to enquire online have no simple option and proof is thin.
findings.fix: A direct enquiry form, WhatsApp and visible reviews.

redesign: Working menus and one phone number.
A direct enquiry form and WhatsApp option.
Proofread copy, reviews and visible registration details.
